# GumSearch Pro & Free Creator Finder
> AI-Powered Digital Product Intelligence & Storefront Analytics for Gumroad

## Overview
GumSearch is a competitor intelligence and creator analytics platform for Gumroad storefronts. It indexes over 100,000+ digital products, ranking creators by verified customer review volume, catalog size, and estimated sales velocity.

## Core Features & Tools
- **Free Creator Finder**: Public tool to rank and discover top Gumroad creators by niche (Notion, AI Prompts, UI Kits, SaaS, E-books).
- **Competitor Analytics**: Analyzes product pricing models, unit sales proxies, and customer dissatisfaction gaps.
- **Mixed Reviews Filter**: Filters high-revenue products with sub-4.0 star ratings to identify high-demand market opportunities.
- **High-Curiosity Teardown Reports**: Generates automated market audit scores and buyer complaint breakdowns.

## Pricing
- **Free Plan**: Unlimited public creator finder searches.
- **GumSearch Pro Lifetime Access Pass**: $99.99 one-time payment for full database export, customer complaint teardowns, and historical sales analytics.
